newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline steady to firmer, some U.S. demand.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline steady to firmer, some U.S. demand.

text.p: NWE gasoline prices were steady to slightly firmer in quiet trade on Monday.

Traders said the combination of the European market contango and the U.S. market backwardation kepT transatlantic activity to a minimum although some interest was seen from the U.S. for 60kt parcels despite the closed arbitrage window.

Traders said there was plenty of oil in Europe but fob avails of easily loadable 60kt parcels were scarce after recent transatlantic sale. On the Rotterdam barge market prompt lifting Eurograde barges talked steady to slightly firmer at $192/$194 fob with amply supplied regular around $8-$9 below this.
Swaps traders valued May contracts at around $196 after trade at the level in the morning.
Eurograde cargoes were thinly talked $196/$198 cif NWE.
